scientific_question: Does fixed-coordinate forced photometry across the exact LUCI1 Br-gamma sequence favor a persistent sky-fixed contribution, a detector-fixed persistent contribution, or leave the one-frame excess origin indeterminate?

forced_fit.patch_center_index_rule: round fixed subpixel x and y to nearest integer; use exactly +/-8 pixels around that integer center; Gaussian template remains centered at the original subpixel coordinate.
forced_fit.model: image = amplitude * fixed circular Gaussian + b0 + bx*(x-x0) + by*(y-y0) + residual
forced_fit.fit_method: ordinary least squares on finite patch pixels
forced_fit.residual_sigma: 1.4826*MAD of fit residuals around their median; fallback sample standard deviation if MAD is nonpositive
forced_fit.background_only_comparison: Also record plane-only residual SSE and Gaussian-plus-plane residual SSE; not a separate discovery criterion.

tracks.SKY_FIXED: Use Q4A-mapped sky-track x/y in A, B, C.
tracks.DETECTOR_FIXED: Use frozen candidate detector x/y in A, B, C.
tracks.DETECTOR_CONTROLS: Use all 13 Q4A same-y fixed detector-control positions in A, B, C.

derived_metrics.constant_flux_compatibility: For A and C separately, abs(B_amp - X_amp)/sqrt(B_sigma^2 + X_sigma^2) <= 3.
derived_metrics.sky_persistence_compatible: Both A_SKY and C_SKY are constant-flux compatible with B.
derived_metrics.detector_persistence_compatible: Both A_DETECTOR and C_DETECTOR are constant-flux compatible with B.
derived_metrics.B_equivalent_detectability: For each A/C track position, B_amp divided by that epoch's forced-fit amplitude_sigma.
derived_metrics.control_temporal_contrast: Same formula at each frozen detector-control position.
derived_metrics.empirical_one_sided_rank_p: (1 + number of control temporal contrasts >= target temporal contrast)/(13+1). Minimum possible p is 1/14 and cannot establish conventional significance by itself.

classification.B_FIXED_EXCESS_NOT_CONFIRMED: B fixed forced_z < 3 or B amplitude <= 0.
classification.EVIDENCE_FAVORS_SKY_FIXED_PERSISTENCE: B fixed excess confirmed; sky persistence compatible; detector persistence incompatible.
classification.EVIDENCE_FAVORS_DETECTOR_FIXED_PERSISTEN: B fixed excess confirmed; detector persistence compatible; sky persistence incompatible.
classification.TRACKS_NOT_DISCRIMINATED: B fixed excess confirmed and both persistence tracks are compatible.
classification.ONE_FRAME_EXCESS_ORIGIN_INDETERMINATE: B fixed excess confirmed and neither persistence track is compatible.
classification.BLOCKED_MEASUREMENT: Any exact frame hash, geometry binding, required target/control fit, finite-pixel, or numerical-stability gate fails.

interpretation_limits.one_frame_sky_transient: If neither persistence track is compatible, a one-frame sky transient and a one-frame detector/cosmic-ray/background event remain competing explanations; Q4B must report INDETERMINATE unless additional artifact-specific evidence is present.
interpretation_limits.control_rank: The 13-control empirical rank is descriptive and cannot alone establish astrophysical origin.
interpretation_limits.closed_external_replication: ZTF/TESS non-replication contributes zero evidential weight to Q4B.

not_admitted: No tachyon, faster-than-light, retrocausal, UAP, artificial, ETI, or nuclear-causality interpretation.
No free centroid or PSF-width optimization after pixel inspection.
No extra LUCI epoch selected after seeing Q4B results.
No control removal because a control is inconvenient.
No claim that persistence failure proves detector artifact; a one-frame sky transient remains possible.
